identity.tagline: Payment origination and documentation software for international B2B trade.
identity.buildStatement: We build the technology layer that lets importing companies originate supplier payments with a complete, auditable documentary record — and we contract licensed payment providers to execute them.

whatWeDo.title: What we do
whatWeDo.headline: Payment origination and documentation software for international B2B trade
whatWeDo.imageAlt: Guira B2B web platform for supplier payment origination and audit trail
paragraphs: Guira System LLC is a US-based software and business-services company. We develop and operate a B2B web platform used by Bolivian small and medium-sized importers to originate and document international supplier payments.

Guira System LLC does not hold, receive, exchange or transmit customer funds. All payment execution and settlement is performed by licensed payment providers in the United States with which we contract, customer funds move only through those licensed providers' accounts and never through Guira System LLC's own accounts.

Our product is the software platform and the documentation package it generates for each transaction: KYC/KYB verification records, supporting commercial documents, a full transaction audit trail and settlement evidence, which our clients use for accounting, customs and audit purposes.

platform.title: The platform
platform.intro: Guira System LLC develops and operates a B2B web application. Client companies use it to originate international supplier payments and to produce the documentary record of each operation.

items.name: Origination
items.description: Structured entry of a supplier payment instruction: payer, beneficiary, amount, currency, stated purpose and the underlying commercial relationship.

items.name: Beneficiary records
items.description: Beneficiary and counterparty records with structured bank routing data. Routing identifiers are validated at entry against their checksum rules and enriched from external business-registry sources before an instruction can proceed.

items.name: Document intake
items.description: Upload and classification of the commercial documents behind each operation: invoice, purchase order, transport and customs documents. Required documents are enforced per operation type; an incomplete instruction cannot advance.

items.name: Verification orchestration
items.description: The platform integrates a specialised third-party provider for identity and business verification (KYC/KYB) and for sanctions and politically-exposed-person screening, and stores the resulting records against the operation.

items.name: Review workflow
items.description: Every instruction enters a review queue and is released by a specialist before it is submitted for execution. Approval is deliberate, not automatic.

items.name: Audit trail
items.description: Every action on an operation is recorded with actor, timestamp and prior state. The trail is append-only and is exported as part of the documentation package.

items.name: Documentation package
items.description: On settlement, the platform assembles verification records, commercial documents, the audit trail and the settlement evidence issued by the executing provider into a single package for the client's accountants, auditors and customs agents.

items.name: Access control
items.description: Multiple named users per client company with role-based permissions. Every action is attributable to an individual user.

steps.name: Origination
steps.text: The client company enters a supplier payment instruction on the platform and uploads the underlying commercial documents.

steps.name: Verification
steps.text: Identity and counterparty verification, sanctions and PEP screening are completed through a specialised third-party provider. Every instruction is reviewed by a specialist before it proceeds.

steps.name: Execution
steps.text: Execution and settlement are performed by licensed payment providers in the United States. Funds move through those providers' accounts. They never move through accounts of Guira System LLC.

steps.name: Documentation
steps.text: The platform assembles the complete record of the operation: verification records, supporting commercial documents, audit trail and settlement evidence.

The execution and settlement stage sits outside that perimeter, in a separate block labelled licensed payment providers, United States, showing that client funds move only through the licensed providers' accounts and never through accounts of Guira System LLC.

deliverables.title: What our clients receive
deliverables.intro: Every operation produces a documentation package built for third-party review:
items: Supporting commercial documents (invoice, purchase order, shipping documents)
A complete transaction audit trail with timestamps
Settlement evidence issued by the executing licensed provider
deliverables.note: Our clients use this package for accounting, customs and audit purposes. This documentation is the product.

dataHandling.title: Platform and data handling
items: The application is delivered over HTTPS. All traffic between the client and the platform is encrypted in transit.
Access is restricted by named user account and role. Administrative actions are logged and attributable to an individual user.
Records for each operation, and the documents attached to it, are retained and remain available to the client for export.
The platform stores commercial and verification records. It does not store cardholder data, and it holds no client funds and no balances of any kind.

items.name: Verification
items.description: A specialised third-party provider for identity and business verification and for sanctions and PEP screening, integrated by API.

items.name: Execution
items.description: Licensed payment providers in the United States, integrated by API. These providers execute and settle the payment and issue the settlement evidence. Client funds move only through their accounts.

whoItIsFor.title: Who it is for
paragraphs: Small and medium-sized importing companies that need to pay international suppliers and must be able to evidence every payment to their accountants, their auditors and their customs authority.
The platform is built for operations where the documentary record matters as much as the transfer: formal commercial imports with invoices, purchase orders and customs exposure.
Access to the platform is currently offered to a limited group of companies.

regulatoryPosition.title: Regulatory position
paragraphs: Guira System LLC is a software and business-services company. It does not hold, receive, exchange or transmit customer funds. It does not maintain customer balances or custody of any kind. It does not operate as a money services business, money transmitter, currency exchange or virtual asset service provider, and it performs no activity requiring a money transmission licence. It is not a bank and it provides no banking services.

Payment execution and settlement are performed exclusively by licensed payment providers in the United States with which the company contracts. Customer funds move only through those providers' accounts and never through accounts of Guira System LLC.

revenue.title: Revenue
revenue.paragraph: Our revenue consists exclusively of platform license and service fees invoiced to our clients, partner fees remitted by the licensed payment providers with which we contract as our contractual share of the fees charged on transactions originated through our platform, and an intercompany service fee from our related party GUIRAGLOBAL S.R.L. (La Paz, Bolivia).

relatedParty.title: Related party
relatedParty.paragraph: GUIRAGLOBAL S.R.L. (La Paz, Bolivia) — a separate Bolivian advisory firm under common ownership. It provides local advisory and documentation support to client companies under a fixed monthly retainer. It does not receive, hold or move client funds, it is not a financial institution, and it charges no transaction-based or ad valorem fee.

compliance.title: Compliance posture
items: Identity verification (KYC/KYB) and sanctions and PEP screening are performed through a specialised third-party provider before onboarding is completed.
Every payment instruction is reviewed by a specialist before it is submitted for execution.
Records for each operation are retained and made available to the client for accounting and audit purposes.
Execution is contracted exclusively with licensed payment providers.
